text:
sam_support: Hey team, customer (acct: acme-inc) opened an escal about invoice spike during 2025-08-12 10:00-11:00Z. Invoice shows ~14,200 tokens billed but their app logs show ~2,350 tokens served. Request IDs: r-9f7a,r-9f7b
julia_billing: Thanks — can you attach the invoice line and the served-token screenshot? We'll need the invoice ID and exact timestamps.
sam_support: attached screenshot https://files.redwood/acme/invoice_INV-20250812-ACME.png and invoice INV-20250812-ACME
nate_infra: quick note: we rolled a change to continuous-batcher prefetching last week that toggles prefetch warmup for low-traffic routes. Prefetch does meter tokens when the runtime loads KV/prefix into cache even if the client request is satisfied from cached prefix later.
maria_eng: ^^^ this. Billing counts tokens the runtime processes (tokenization + forward pass) during prefetch warmup. Console 'served_tokens' counts only tokens emitted to the client. That explains billed > served.
sam_support: ok can we prove it with traces/logs for the customer's requests?
nate_infra: yes — from runtime logs: `METER token_count=11340 action=prefetch route=/v1/generate req=r-9f7a` then later `SERVE tokens=1249 req=r-9f7a`. I'll paste full snippet.
metering-bot: [automated] meter:ts=2025-08-12T10:02:17Z req=r-9f7a tokens=11340 type=prefetch
metering-bot: [automated] meter:ts=2025-08-12T10:02:18Z req=r-9f7a tokens=1249 type=served
julia_billing: Given that, policy is we don't auto-credit prefetch/warmup unless it's due to a bug/rollout. We can offer a one-time goodwill adjustment if customer has low tolerance; need invoice ID and confirmation they didn't hit old code path.
sam_support: Customer asks if we can disable prefetch for their workspace or exclude warmup from billing. Any short-term options?
maria_eng: We can set route config `prefetch_mode=disabled` or `prefetch_on_warmup=false` for dedicated/private or for individual tenants via feature flag. It's not retroactive.
julia_billing: I'll flag for potential adjustment pending confirmation. Sam — please collect full request logs and send to billing@redwood.com with INV-20250812-ACME and the runtime snippets.
sam_support: will do. tagging @nate_infra for log export help. :thumbsup:
nate_infra: happy to export. I'll run the query: `select * from meter_logs where req in ('r-9f7a','r-9f7b')` and attach a CSV.
sam_support: Thanks — closing loop with customer after billing confirms.
